starbasePad.prompt: Create ONE production game sprite, isolated on a truly transparent background, for a 2D side-view satirical paper cutout game. Subject: SpaceX Starbase Starship launch infrastructure, WITHOUT ANY ROCKET, no vehicle, no people, no sky, no scenery. A tall rectangular grey steel lattice launch tower on the RIGHT, large clearly drawn X braces, stacked service floors, small red warning lights, two short mechanical catching arms extending left near the upper third. To its LEFT and near ground level: a large EMPTY circular orbital launch mount viewed from side, thick dark steel ring supported by 6 stout splayed concrete/steel legs, clear open central space under the ring for rocket exhaust. Include a broad grounded concrete foundation strip, small pipes and two squat service tanks at far right on the foundation. Mount top should be about 12 percent of total sprite height above bottom, mount center about 38 percent of sprite width; tower is 90 percent of sprite height, tower center about 73 percent of sprite width. Nothing in the vertical launch corridor above the mount. Orthographic side elevation, no aerial perspective. Whole object fully within frame with modest 4 percent transparent margin. Distinctive tactile torn construction-paper collage, South Park cut-paper look, graphite silver and muted blue grey cardstock, warm cream irregular thin paper cut edge, simple readable chunky shapes, subtle paper grain. Attractive crafted asset, coherent night-game muted palette yet readable. Tall portrait composition 2:3. No text, no letters, no logo, no shadows outside foundation. Do NOT include rocket.

obstacleStyleV21.notes: Five photorealistic car cutouts and an AI-generated photographic-style Amber Heard head. These are generated images, not documentary photos. Transparent source retained. Sprite cells, alpha-connected-component cleanup and proportional ground anchors are defined in src/photo-cutouts.js. Humans retain paper-cutout bodies; couch faces use round South Park-inspired proportions. Island pavilion removed from obstacle catalog.
obstacleStyleV21.promptSummary: Transparent 3-by-2 atlas: orange Dodge Charger, steel Cybertruck, burgundy Mustang, teal Camaro, tan pickup, recognizable Amber Heard head. Photographic textures, side-on cars facing right, thin warm-white cut edge, no scenery.

roadsterFlipV22.method: Nine actual browser video captures; AI-assisted background removal, exposure correction and horizontal mirroring in one sheet; alpha component cleanup and proportional frame normalization. Retouched video-derived assets, not untouched video pixels.
roadsterFlipV22.anchor: shared visual centre; 232 px visible car length
roadsterFlipV22.playback: Nine poses selected from normalized jump time, upright frame at takeoff and landing; no rotation or squash transforms.
roadsterFlipV22.rollingLayers: Runtime Canvas caches split the original upright frame into body, photographed tyres and circular original rims. Rim exposure is doubled once for readability; no replacement wheel art. Contact baseline 112.5 of 160 source pixels; damped cosmetic body suspension, wheel rotation from simulated speed.

spaceportV23.notes: One transparent 16-cell atlas: rocket, pad, hangar, crawler, 4 exhaust, 4 dust/smoke, 4 explosion frames. Shared blue-gray paper palette, atmosphere tint cached at load. No foreground sticker border.
spaceportV23.promptSummary: Muted cut-paper night spaceport, slate smoke, terracotta/amber engine and explosion, 4 by 4 transparent atlas; no labels or scenery background.
